tools.name: find_calm_idea
tools.description: Suggests Breatho & Friends calming helpers for a child's tricky moment or big feeling, such as bedtime, the dentist, haircuts, school drop-off, loud noises, waiting, worries or big angry feelings. Returns the matching moment and 1-3 simple calming moves to try.

tools.name: breathing_game
tools.description: Gives one short, playful Breatho & Friends breathing or calming game a grown-up can do with a child right now, with simple steps.

tools.name: card_of_the_day
tools.description: Returns today's Breatho & Friends card: a friendly creature with one calming move to try together today.

tools.name: about_breatho_and_friends
tools.description: Explains what Breatho & Friends cards are and how to play, and lists the card decks on the Calm Family Printables website with their current prices and a link.
